providers.systemHint: Built-in providers can be enabled/disabled but their base URL, auth wiring, and whitelist are read-only.

providers.writeEnabledOff: Full access revoked for {{name}}; only the default safe set remains
providers.writeWarning: By default only each provider's safe set (typically read-only GET) is allowed. Turning on "Allow writes" grants the AI full method/path access — review each provider before enabling.

orchestration.title: Orchestration Cost Guardrails
orchestration.description: Bound the AI-native board orchestrator. Changes apply within a few seconds — no restart needed. The budget is enforced per orchestration tree (an epic plus its child workspaces).
orchestration.budgetHint: Cumulative cost cap for one orchestration tree. 0 disables the cap. Whole dollars only.
orchestration.maxConcurrentHint: Per-owner concurrent active workspaces. Over the cap, start_workspace queues instead of rejecting. 0 disables.
orchestration.maxBatchHint: Cap on how many issues one batch_create_issues call may create. 0 disables.
orchestration.warnRatioHint: Fraction of the budget at which the orchestrator is flagged to confirm before fanning out further.

gitIdentity.title: Git Author Identity
gitIdentity.description: The author niuniu records on commits it makes on your behalf. Used by the Claude CLI agent in your workspaces.
gitIdentity.emailHint: Empty means niuniu will use the synthetic "<username>@niuniu.local" so commits still succeed.
gitIdentity.invalidEmail: Email must be a valid address or empty.
gitIdentity.perRepoNote: Different identity for a specific repository? Open that repository's Settings tab to set a per-repo override (e.g. Alice's company email for the company repo, personal email elsewhere).

gitCredentials.title: Git Remote Credentials (SSH)
gitCredentials.description: Upload per-host SSH private keys so Claude (and you) can push / pull / clone in workspaces. Treat as the OS keychain equivalent — keys are AES-GCM encrypted at rest, only materialized into a per-PTY temp dir when a session needs them.
gitCredentials.hostHint: One key per host. Wildcards (e.g. "*") are allowed for catch-all configurations.
gitCredentials.addDescription: Paste an unencrypted OpenSSH private key. niuniu derives and stores the matching public key + fingerprint so you can verify it later.
gitCredentials.deleteConfirm: Delete the SSH key for {{host}}? Workspaces using it will fail to authenticate against {{host}} until you add a new key.

field.usernameHint: Almost always "git" — only change for self-hosted setups that use a different SSH login.
field.privateKeyHint: Paste the unencrypted private key. Passphrase-protected keys are not supported; decrypt locally first.

gitCredentials.securityNote: Private keys are AES-GCM encrypted at rest with the integration master secret. They are never returned to clients, never written to .git/config, and only materialized to /tmp/<per-PTY-dir>/id_<host> at session start (0600 perms, removed on PTY exit).
gitCredentials.errInvalidPrivateKey: The pasted key could not be parsed as an SSH private key.
gitCredentials.errPassphraseRequired: Passphrase-protected keys are not supported. Decrypt the key locally first.
gitCredentials.errInvalidHost: Host must be a single token without whitespace or shell metacharacters.
gitCredentials.errHostConflict: You already have a credential for this host. Delete the existing one first.
